For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of posting sensitive details here. Remove credentials, private media and identifying information from logs/screenshots.

**Source/package:** commit and package digest, if available.

**Environment:** OS, browser, source/internal candidate, Blender/Unity version if relevant.

**Steps:** minimal numbered reproduction using a synthetic sample or authorized non-sensitive input.

**Expected behavior:**

**Observed behavior:** include visible error and whether saved original motion/backup remained available.

**Redacted diagnostics:** optional minimal excerpt; do not attach `.env`, keys, private video, user data folders or unredacted runtime logs.
